summary: Frontend-only test of new Home sidebar (Playwright, 1920x1080 + 390px). Working: seed data (Clientes/c1, Fixados c2, Anteriores c3), search filter by title/prompt + clear + Ctrl+K focus + sb-empty, new folder w/ inline focused rename, folder toggle, folder rename/delete (chats return to root), chat rename (Enter commits / Esc cancels), pin/unpin, move to folder / root, delete, menus close on outside click + Escape, chat row opens workspace, collapse to 64px rail (persists after reload; rail search expands+focuses, rail new folder, rail new chat focuses composer), user menu -> settings opens project-settings, localStorage persistence, no console errors. Found and FIXED 4 bugs (see rca).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: new chat created from composer (Enter) was never saved/shown under 'Hoje' - state update lost because HomeScreen unmounts in same batch as view->workspace
FIXED: folder ⋯ menu rendered underneath the folder's child chat rows (each .sb-item is a stacking context due to fill-mode animation), so 'Renomear' was not clickable on non-empty folders
FIXED: chat ⋯ menu inside a folder was clipped by .sb-folder-inner overflow:hidden (only 'Renomear' visible)
FIXED: typing a SPACE in folder rename input (input is nested inside the toggle <button>) triggered the toggle and collapsed the folder

issues: Sidebar is fully hidden on mobile (<=760px) with no hamburger/drawer toggle - chats/folders are unreachable on mobile. No horizontal overflow otherwise.
A pinned chat inside a folder shows the pin icon but stays in the folder (not under Fixados) - may be confusing
With .sb-folder-inner now overflow:visible when open, content may briefly overflow during the 260ms expand animation; consider toggling overflow after transitionend

action_items: Add a mobile drawer/hamburger to access the sidebar at <=760px
Optional: move InlineEdit out of the <button> (input inside button is invalid HTML) instead of relying on the editing guard
Optional: decide UX for pinned chats inside folders
Note: opening a chat (sb-chat-open) calls onCreate(prompt) which derives project name from the first 3 words of the prompt - no real chat/project identity is restored
critical_code_review_comments: InlineEdit: Enter commits then unmount/blur may call commit again (harmless now)
Seed createdAt uses Date.now()-2h/5h; near midnight seeded 'today' chats can fall into 'Anteriores'
load() trusts JSON shape from localStorage without validation

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fixes (4 bugs fixed by tester, 1 mobile design gap open)

seed_data_creation: None - uses built-in seed; clear localStorage keys hall.sidebar.v1 and hall.sidebar.collapsed for clean state
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wait 4.5s after load for intro splash. Hover row before clicking sb-chat-menu-{id}. All sidebar flows verified after fixes in iteration 4.
rca of the issue: 1) Composer new chat lost: store.addChat setState + App setView('workspace') batch together; HomeScreen unmounts so queued update and the persist useEffect never run. Fix: write localStorage synchronously in addChat. 2) Folder menu under children: .sb-item has animation sbIn with fill-mode both on transform -> creates stacking context per row; later rows paint over z-index:40 menu. Fix: raise .sb-item.menu-open z-index. 3) Menu clipped: .sb-folder-inner overflow:hidden (needed for grid collapse). Fix: overflow visible when open. 4) Space toggles folder: input nested in button; space keyup activates parent button. Fix: guard toggle with !editing.
